claims.text: During his chieftainship the Orcs of the Misty Mountains became more bold, daring to invade Eriador. The Rangers fought many battles trying to hold them back, but one party of Orcs managed to reach the Shire, where they were fought off by a party of brave Hobbits under Bandobras "Bullroarer" Took in at the Battle of Greenfields.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "The Númenorean Kings", "Eriador, Arnor, and the Heirs of Isildur"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix B, "The Third Age"

claims.text: Also during this time, in , the Long Winter arrived. Many lives were lost, and Gandalf and the Rangers had to help the Hobbits of the Shire survive.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix B, "The Third Age"

claims.text: After having been chieftain for 65 years, Arassuil died in 2784. He was succeeded by his son, Arathorn I.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "The Númenorean Kings", "The Realms in Exile", "The Northern Line: Heirs of Isildur"

claims.text:
In an early manuscript Arassuil's name was "Arasuil".
